target_customer: Consumers sending money across borders, initially in Argentina
problem: Crypto peer to peer payments have poor UX, and bank transfers across borders are slow and expensive.
business_model: Free self-custodial stablecoin wallet; monetization not found

founders.name: Daniel Nordh
founders.role: Founder (author of the YC launch post)
founders.background_notes: The YC page lists no founder names; the launch post was posted by Daniel Nordh and names no other founders.

technical_complexity.rationale: Non-custodial wallet with email and phone lookup, gasless transactions and cloud backup on Polygon needs real crypto engineering by two people.

defensibility.rationale: Wallet UX is easily copied and no network effect or license was documented.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source describes incumbent action; the launch post compared ease of use to Venmo only.

market_need_then: The YC launch post cites poor crypto payment UX and Argentine users adding and withdrawing pesos; no usage data was found.

branding.name_origin: Originally Paymobil; the reason for the rename to Peg is not stated in any source found

brand_strength.rationale: Short real word name; the App Store developer account still reads Paymobil, but no press or community evidence of brand strength was found.

outcome_analysis: Peg, formerly Paymobil, built a self-custodial USDC wallet on Polygon with free transactions and launched early 2020. The YC directory data marks it Inactive, yet the App Store listing still shows active maintenance releases, so the true status is unclear and no shutdown, acquisition or post-mortem was found. Cause of any stop is not public.
notes: peg.money did not resolve from this session. The directory says Inactive but a search summary said the YC page showed Active and the App Store shows version 3.7.9; status conflict unresolved. The 500K convertible note rests on CB Insights alone. No competitors dated near the batch were found: Valora and MiniPay launched 2021 and 2023. Daniel Nordh is recorded from the launch post only.
